unindexed_sources.rationale: pip-audit cannot hash or index a Git requirement. The immutable upstream commit and public advisory page were checked; no public repository advisories were returned on the review date. This is a source identity/advisory-feed review, not a full source vulnerability scan or model qualification. All registry transitive dependencies remain in the audit. Re-checked 13 October 2026 (ship E2, at the owner's delegation): the locked commit is unchanged and the repository's security advisories endpoint returns no advisories.
